summary: Enriched issue-15 premium-membership ticket with product-level problem/impact/success/acceptance framing, confidence indicators, dependency mapping to #2/#3/#11/#16, and surfaced 3 blocking + 2 non-blocking ambiguities.
follow_ups: Repo is a bare Next.js skeleton (only /api/health); premium membership depends on unimplemented issues #2 (auth), #3 (schema), #11 (download endpoint), and #16 (free-tier limits). Most requirements are Unverified against code as expected for an early roadmap ticket.
Confirm whether 'extended storage' and 'exclusive features' perks belong in this ticket or should be filed separately.

open_questions.q: Which payment/billing provider will back premium subscriptions (e.g. Stripe or other)?
open_questions.proposed_answer: Assume a third-party provider like Stripe; determines what 'billing failures handled gracefully' asserts.

open_questions.q: Does 'higher download limits' mean a larger fixed monthly cap or unlimited downloads for premium users?
open_questions.proposed_answer: Unquantified; changes the pass/fail of the 'bypass free-tier limits' criterion.

open_questions.q: On cancel/downgrade, does reversion to free tier happen immediately or at end of paid period, and how is over-cap current-month usage handled?
open_questions.proposed_answer: Undefined; typical SaaS keeps access until period end, but must be confirmed.

open_questions.q: Pricing model — monthly vs annual, price points, trials, proration?
open_questions.proposed_answer: Likely a product decision; affects renewal/proration criteria but not core flow.
